name: al-hikmah-ai
description: Platform Qur'an & Hadits berbasis AI — orkestrasi dev backend + frontend dalam satu perintah

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && pip install -r requirements.txt
